cases.title: Clicking Add Note button creates and appends a new note with textarea
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Add note button creates a new note appended to the document body as a div element with the class note containing a visible empty textarea with data-testid="note-textarea", and supports multiple rapid clicks creating separate notes.

cases.title: Markdown input renders dynamically in real-time with proper HTML formatting
cases.description: Verify that as the user types Markdown content into the textarea, it is dynamically rendered in the main display area with proper HTML formatting.

cases.title: Invalid Markdown displays raw input upon exiting edit mode
cases.description: Verify that complex or invalid Markdown syntax does not cause crashes or errors, and instead displays the raw input when the user exits the edit mode by clicking the Edit button.

cases.title: Markdown edits are reflected immediately in local storage
cases.description: Verify that all changes made to a note during Markdown editing are reflected immediately in local storage to persist the current state.

cases.title: Default edit mode upon new note creation
cases.description: Verify that when a new note is created by clicking the "Add note" button, it immediately enters edit mode where the textarea is visible and the main content area remains hidden.

cases.title: Switching between edit and view modes
cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Edit" button toggles the note between edit and view modes, showing either the textarea or the main content area respectively.

cases.title: Automatic saving of textarea changes to local storage
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage to preserve the note state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note removes it from DOM and local storage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the delete button (data-testid="delete-note-button") removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes its corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Retrieve and render saved notes from localStorage with content
cases.description: Verify that when the webpage loads with stored notes containing content, the app dynamically creates a div with the class note containing a tools div with edit and delete buttons, a main div (data-testid="note-main") showing the note content, and a textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") which is hidden by default.

cases.title: Render saved notes with no content showing textarea
cases.description: Verify that when retrieving stored notes that have no content, the app shows the textarea and hides the main div for immediate editing.

cases.title: Load app when localStorage is empty
cases.description: Verify that when the webpage loads and localStorage is empty, no notes are shown.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and explicit behaviors from the prompt are thoroughly and correctly covered by the provided test cases. No blockers or missing scenarios were found.
All requirements and corresponding test cases are fully aligned and cover all explicit operations, boundary states, and conditions without any blockers or missing scenarios.
